_note: Chapter 12, Ashmere station: ash highlands, the Stilling freezes Spirlings mid-step (plan item 1482).

say: The railway car groans to a stop. Grey flakes drift past the window. Not snow. Ash.
On the platform a Kindlop stands mid-step, one paw raised. It doesn't move.
Here the Hush has another name. The Stilling. It freezes Spirlings where they stand.
Find master graver Halvard in Cinderfold. Ysolde said he'd know what to do.
